# Cognitive FX

> > Evidence-based neuroimaging-guided treatment for concussion, post-concussion syndrome, depression, and autonomic disorders using fNCI imaging and advanced brain stimulation therapies.

Cognitive FX is a specialized treatment center offering innovative, evidence-based programs for brain injuries and mental health conditions. The clinic utilizes functional neuroimaging (fNCI and fMRI) to guide personalized rehabilitation and brain stimulation protocols, with published research demonstrating clinical outcomes across 1,000+ patients.

## Key Topics

- Functional Neuroimaging (fNCI/fMRI)
- Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS)
- Post-Concussion Syndrome (PCS)
- EPIC Treatment Program
- Concussion Recovery
- Treatment-Resistant Depression
- POTS (Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome)
- Brain Imaging
- Clinical Outcomes
- Neuroplasticity
- Cognitive Rehabilitation
- Depression Treatment
- Long COVID
- Patient Testimonials
- Clinical Research

## Core Treatment Programs

- [EPIC Concussion Treatment Overview](https://www.cognitivefxusa.com/treatment): EPIC treatment program overview: fNCI-guided concussion rehabilitation at Cognitive FX
- [Precision Mental Health - fMRI Guided Transcranial Magnetic Stim](https://www.cognitivefxusa.com/precision-mental-health-fmri-guided-transcranial-magnetic-stim): fMRI-guided TMS for depression, treatment-resistant depression, and anxiety
- [One D TMS - One-Day TMS: Accelerated Depression Treatment Protocol](https://www.cognitivefxusa.com/one-d-tms-one-day-tms-accelerated-depression-treatment-protocol): ONE-D accelerated TMS protocol for treatment-resistant depression with neuroplasticity enhancement
- [Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome Treatment Clinic](https://www.cognitivefxusa.com/pots-treatment): POTS treatment program targeting autonomic nervous system and brainstem dysfunction
- [Other Brain Injuries](https://www.cognitivefxusa.com/other-types-of-injuries): EPIC treatment outcomes for stroke, hemorrhage, and surgical brain complications
